name: Agency hero: a genuinely live availability status computed in the business's own timezone, honest enough to say nobody is awake
notes: Signature effect: a status that is actually computed instead of a green dot that is always on. Reads the real hour in America/Chicago through Intl.DateTimeFormat.formatToParts, NOT the visitor's clock (which would tell a customer in London that Denton is awake at 4am) and NOT a hardcoded offset (which would be wrong twice a year at the daylight saving shift). Four honest states, and the one that sells is the overnight branch: 'Asleep, almost certainly. Read before 8:00 AM.' Verified by stubbing the Date constructor to 07:30 UTC and confirming it produced 2:30 AM and the asleep state. If the visitor's zone differs, the footnote tells them their own local time, which proves the clock on screen is not just their own. Seconds tick, because a clock that does not is a picture of a clock, but the interval drops to 60s under reduced motion and stops entirely while the tab is hidden. Tabular numerals are load-bearing here: without them the layout shifts every second. Part of the ten hero 940Digital brand series (sections 0027 to 0036); the series log, the contact sheet that renders all ten live, and the written recommendation are in brand-heroes/set-evidence/. Unlike the client-derived sections in this library, this one is NOT de-identified: 940Digital is Owen's own business, so there is no third party to protect and the real wordmark, palette and copy are the point of the section. Brand rules baked in across the whole series: display type at weight 500 with about -0.03em tracking (not 700); #3194E0 never carries text on a light background because it measures 2.90:1, so blue text on sand is #1F6FB0 and a blue fill takes a charcoal label at 5.18:1; every figure is JetBrains Mono with tabular-nums; text containers are sized in ch, not px.
